label: Randomness, loot and rewards
summary: Model unpredictable outcomes, loot allocation and reward claims with explicit entropy, replay and solvency guarantees.
requiredFacts: Entropy source, request and fulfillment lifecycle, confirmations, expiry and outage fallback
Who can influence inputs, reorder fulfillment, retry, cancel or replace the randomness provider
Loot table, probabilities, supply, scarcity, duplicate policy and public odds disclosure
Reward funding, reservation, claim authorization, replay boundary and unclaimed-value treatment
Jurisdiction, age, purchase and promotional constraints requiring owner legal review
requiredTests: Request, fulfill, expire, retry, cancel and duplicate fulfillment lifecycle
Replay, reorg, delayed callback, provider rotation and malicious fulfillment
Loot supply, probability, reservation and reward-solvency conservation
Deterministic fixture tests plus documented statistical tests with fixed seeds
Front-running, selective reveal, reroll and input-manipulation scenarios
risks: Manipulable or selectively revealed entropy can redirect valuable outcomes
Unreserved rewards or duplicate fulfillment can make claims insolvent
Loot mechanics can create legal or platform-policy obligations beyond contract correctness
